description: Search in-stock products JENNi can deliver to a 5-digit US ZIP: local delivery first, then ship-to-home. Every product returned can be ordered; price is per unit, before the delivery or shipping fee. A product with variants and no price is a size or colour family: buy one of its variants. Sized goods are often listed one size per product: put the size in the query and match it against size or title. Pass fulfillment_mode to search one mode. More results: call again with page+1 while page < paging.total_pages.

fulfillment_mode.description: Search one mode only. Omit to list local delivery first, filled with ship-to-home.

market.description: Market key, e.g. san-antonio-tx. Used when no zip is given.

page.description: 1-based results page; call again with page+1 while page < paging.total_pages.

query.description: What the shopper wants, e.g. "running shoes".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code the shopper is in, e.g. 78205.

name: search_catalog

note.description: What could not be checked (for example local delivery): that availability is unknown, not unavailable.

delivery_promise.description: Local delivery: "Get it today" or "We'll deliver by <Month D>". Ship-to-home: "Ships to you".

price.description: Unit price in USD, before the delivery or shipping fee. Absent on a size or colour family: pick a variant.

size.description: Absent when none is recorded; the size may then be in the title.

url.description: Product page on JENNi, already carrying the shopper's ZIP.

variants.description: Sizes or colours, each with its own product_id. For a family (no price), get_buying_options and start_checkout need a variant's product_id.

reason_code.description: Present only when products is empty.

title: Search products
